'''Lank's farm''' was a [[Farm/Legends|farm]] owned by [[Bels Lank]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. He lived there with his daughter, [[Reen (Tatooinian)|Reen]], until the farm was razed by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[IG-72/Legends|IG-72]] during the [[Escape from Tatooine|Hunt for Adar Tallon]]. IG-72 targeted Lank in a case of mistaken identity after overhearing [[4-LB]] give information to a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[operative]]s which indicated that he might be [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]]. Bels Lank was [[Death/Legends|killed]], but his daughter survived.<ref name="TM" />
